ms.report:
Milestone 2 
Proof of Achievement

For Milestone 2, we have successfully completed all planned outputs and met the acceptance criteria, advancing the Eth2Ada platform with robust AI tooling integration. 

Research and selection of AI tools 
Comprehensive research was conducted to evaluate AI tools suitable to enhance user experience on the Eth2Ada portal. Documentation outlines the features, scalability, and alignment of selected tools with project goals. 

Evidence: Research Paper

Justification reports clearly articulate why the chosen tools were selected, validated by team approval. 

Evidence: Team Approval Letter

Integration of AI tools into the online portal 

AI tools have been seamlessly integrated into the Eth2Ada portal, enhancing user interaction and functionality. Screenshots and video demos showcase the successful implementation. 

Evidence: GrokAI Integration 
Evidence: Video Tour
Evidence: xAI Live Chat Agent terminal 

Compatibility testing confirms smooth operation across devices and browsers, with repository records documenting the integration process. The adding and editing of terms, and subsequent future contribution workflow was streamlined using github. Anyone with a github account is now welcome to contribute to the project and make requests to add or edit terms.

Evidence: Github Link
Evidence: Github Readme 
Evidence: Public Managed Repository of dictionary data

Testing and refinement of AI tools 

Extensive testing was conducted to ensure optimal performance, with detailed test plans and reports validating functionality. We conducted thorough testing of Grok Premium’s integration into the Eth2Ada portal, focusing on response accuracy, query handling speed, and user interaction flows. Our test plan included 50 Cardano-specific queries (e.g., “What is Cardano staking?”) and stress tests for up to 1,000 concurrent users. Reports confirm 96% accuracy on query responses and an average response time of 1.2 seconds. 

Evidence, Test Plan & Repor

1. Summary
The Eth2Ada project has successfully delivered a developer tools and resources hub to onboard non-Cardano developers, meeting all objectives set in our Catalyst proposal. From March 2024 to April 2025, eth2ada.com evolved into an educational portal with enhanced UI, AI support, and community resources, fostering Cardano adoption.
・Milestone 1: Revamped the portal with a daily Term of the Day and updated terminology.
・Milestone 2: Integrated Grok Premium for AI-driven support, achieving 96% query accuracy.
・Milestone 3: Delivered webinars and toolkits

This report outlines our achievements, successes, challenges, and impact.
2. Project Objectives
・Build an accessible portal for non-Cardano developers to learn Cardano.
・Provide AI-powered support and daily educational content.
・Offer webinars, workshops and tools to enable development.
・Ensure resources are clear and relevant for diverse users.
